productPitch: LeadFlow AI sells 'Meridian', a B2B analytics platform that gives revenue teams real-time pipeline forecasting and automated reporting, replacing spreadsheet-based sales ops.
targetCustomer: B2B software or services companies with a sales team of 5+ reps, currently using spreadsheets or a basic CRM for pipeline reporting. Primary buyers are Heads of Sales, RevOps leads, and COOs at companies between 20 and 500 employees.

criteria.name: industry_fit
criteria.description: The lead's company operates in B2B software, technology services, or another industry with a structured sales pipeline.

criteria.name: buyer_role
criteria.description: The contact appears to hold a revenue, operations, or leadership role with influence over sales tooling decisions.

criteria.name: pain_signal
criteria.description: The lead's message or company context signals a concrete pain the product solves (manual reporting, forecasting gaps, scaling sales ops).

criteria.name: company_size_fit
criteria.description: Company appears to be roughly 20-500 employees — big enough to need the product, small enough to buy quickly.

criteria.name: urgency
criteria.description: The lead expresses timeline or intent to evaluate solutions soon.
